p. p. [आप्-क्त] 
__1 Got, obtained, gained; °कामः, °शापः &c. 
__2 Reached, overtaken, equalled, engrossed; यदिदं सर्वं मृत्युनाप्तं सर्वं मृत्युनाभिपन्नं केन यजमानो मृत्योराप्तिमतिमुच्यते [[Bṛ.

.]] 
__3 Reaching to, extending as far as. 
__4 Trustworthy, reliable, credible (as news &c.). 
__5 [Page0337-2] Trusty, confidential, faithful (person); कुमारभृत्याकुशलैरनुष्टिते भिषग्भिराप्तैः [[

.]] 
___(b) Apt, fit. 
__7 Full, complete, abundant; न सत्यं दानमानौ वा यज्ञो वाप्याप्तदक्षिणः [[

.]] 
__8 True, exact. 
__9 Intimate, closely related, acquainted; कन्यायाः किल पूजयन्ति पितरो जामातुराप्तं जनम् [[

.]] 
__10 Appointed. 
__11 Generally received, commonly used; authentic. 
__12 Accused, prosecuted. 
__13 Reasonable, sensible. 
__14 Beneficial, useful; अधिष्टितं हयज्ञेन सूतेनाप्तोपदेशिना [[

.]] 
-प्तः 
__1 A trustworthy, reliable, or fit person; credible person or source, guarantee; आप्तः यथार्थवक्ता [[T. S.]] 
__2 A relative, friend; निग्रहात्स्वसुराप्तानां वधाच्च धनदानुजः [[

]]; 8. 64. 
__3 An Arhat. 
-प्ता A twisted lock of hair (जटा). 
-प्तम् 
__1 A quotient. 
__2 (In Math.) Equation of a degree. 
-Comp. 
-आगमः Proper knowledge परोक्षमाप्तागमात् सिद्धम् [[Sāṅ.

.]] 
-आधीन a. Dependent on trustworthy person. 
-उक्तिः f. 
__1 an augment. 
__2 an affix. 3 a word of received acceptation and established by usage only; see आप्तवाच् also. 
-काम a. 
__1 one who has obtained his desire; येनाकमन्त्यृषयो ह्याप्रकामाः [[

.]] 
__2 one who has renounced all worldly desires and attachments. 
(-मः) the Supreme Soul. 
-कारिन् a. doing things in a fit or confidential manner; अरक्षिता गृहे रुद्धाः पुरुषैराप्तकारिभिः [[
.]] m. a trusty, agent or confidential servant; तस्माद्गच्छन्तु पुरुषाः स्मारणायाप्तकारिणः [[

.]] 
-गर्भा a pregnant woman. 
-दक्षिण a. having proper or abundant gifts. 
-वचनम् 
__1 received text or authority, revelation. 
__2 the words of a credible or trustworthy person; [[

.]] 
-वाच् a. worthy of belief, regarded as authority, one whose words are credible and authoritative; परातिसंधानमधीयते यैर्बिद्येति ते सन्तु किलाप्तवाचः [[Ś. 5. 25.]] f. 
__1 the advice of a friend or credible person. 
__2 the Vedas or Śruti; a word of authority (said to apply to Smṛtis, Itihāsas and Purāṇas also, which are considered as authoritative evidence); आप्तवागनुमानाभ्यां साध्यं त्वां प्रति का कथा [[

.]] 
-श्रुतिः f. 
__1 the Vedas. 
__2 Smṛtis &c. आप्तश्रुतिराप्तबचनम् तु । [[Sāṅ.

a. Ved. Busy, active, industrious. 
-प्तुः (or n. [[

]]) 
__1 The body. 
__2 Soma (सूक्ष्मरूपसोम). 
__3 A sacrificial animal.

अप्तु,
 
-प्तू -र्यम् [अप्तुरो भावः बाहु °वेदे यत्] Sending down water (वृष्टिप्रेरकत्वम्), giving of water; zeal, activity युवोरप्तूर्यं हितम् [[

m. [अद्भ्यः जलदानाय तुतोर्ति, जलानि प्रेरयति, तुर् क्विप् [[Tv.]]] 
__1 Active, busy, giving water, flowing as water; an epithet of Indra ([[Sāy.]] अपां प्रेरक इन्द्रः). 
__2 Fire.

अप्तोर्यामः,
 
-मन् m. N. of a sacrifice and of a verse of the Sāma Veda closing that rite; the last or 7th part of the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice.
A kind of यज्ञ in the सप्तसोमसंस्था.

a. [अप्तुनि देहे भवः यत् वेदे टिलोपः [[Tv.]]] 
__1 Engaged in an act, active (देहकर्मणि स्थित). 
__2 Offspring (अपत्य [[Nir.]]).

f. [आप्-क्तिन्] 
__1 Getting obtaining, gain, acquisition; ध्यायन्ति वेदहृदया मुनयस्तदाप्त्यै [[

.]] मित्र°, काम° &c. 
__2 Reaching, overtaking, meeting with; केन यजमानो मृत्योराप्तिमतिमुच्यते [[Bṛ.

.]] 
__3 Binding, connection, relation. 
__4 Union; especially with a woman ([[Med.]]). 
__5 Fitness, aptitude, propriety. 
__6 Completion, fulfilment; कामस्याप्तिं जगतः प्रतिष्ठाम् [[Kaṭh.

.]] 
__7 Future time. -pl. N. of 12 sacrificial verses beginning with Āpaye. [[
Ved. N. of a class of deities, especially of the deity Trita as belonging to that class.
